meta.name: Living With Evil: Diabolical
meta.description:
Watch the exposure of the dark side of human nature, where seemingly ordinary lives hide chilling secrets. Hear true stories of betrayal, obsession, and murder—proving that evil can live closer than you think.

Shows: Diabolical, Pandora's Box: Unleashing Evil, Dangerous Persuasions, Wives with Knives, American Monster
Available on: Pluto TV, Tubi, Plex
